seo.title: Working with Us
seo.description: Work with Arg Software when architecture, reliability, and senior execution matter from the first technical decision to production.

title: Work With
Arg Software
hero.subtitle: Work with a small architecture-first team that designs the system before writing it, then stays close when it reaches production.

aside.text: ARG is a small, opinionated engineering team. We take on hard problems on purpose: systems where architecture, reliability, and ownership matter from day one.
aside.label: ARG Team

pillars.title: Diagram first. Then code.
pillars.description: Every engagement opens with a written technical plan you can argue with. Two days on architecture beats two weeks unpicking a wrong call.

pillars.title: The systems that cannot fall over.
pillars.description: Open-payment rails, real-time audio sync, exchange order flow. The work where "usually works" is not good enough.

pillars.title: Gold standard, not trendy.
pillars.description: Battle-tested tools we have used under pressure, not the ones with the loudest feed. Clean code, clear ownership, easy hand-off when we are done.

values.title: Four things we actually mean.
values.subtitle: Most companies list values that could belong to anyone. Ours are operational: they decide what we ship, what we refuse, and who fits on the team.

items.title: Architecture first
items.description: The system is designed before it's written. If we can't explain it clearly, we don't build it yet.

items.title: No patchwork
items.description: If a fix needs a workaround, we refactor the abstraction. Band-aids compound; we'd rather pay the cost now.

items.title: Production on a Tuesday
items.description: We deploy when we can stay close. We own what we ship: bugs, performance, and the unexpected page.

items.title: Direct, kind, no politics
items.description: Honest in code review, honest in retro. Small team means every personality compounds.

fitCheck.title: Not every project needs ARG.
fitCheck.intro: Before we talk scope, we look for the shape of the problem: where the risk is, what needs to stay reliable, and whether a small senior team can make a real difference.

checks.title: High-stakes architecture
checks.description: You are making decisions that will shape the product for years: platform design, migrations, integrations, or a system that needs to scale without becoming fragile.

checks.title: Production reliability
checks.description: The system is already live, or close to it, and performance, observability, recovery, or operational confidence matters more than another feature sprint.

checks.title: Senior execution
checks.description: You do not need a large vendor layer. You need people who can reason about the product, write the code, and stay accountable when it reaches production.

conversationSteps.title: Send context
conversationSteps.description: Share the product, constraint, or technical risk you need to solve.

conversationSteps.title: We review the problem
conversationSteps.description: We look for fit before suggesting calls, proposals, or unnecessary process.

conversationSteps.title: You speak with someone technical
conversationSteps.description: The first conversation is with someone who can reason about the system.

conversationSteps.title: We suggest the next move
conversationSteps.description: You leave with a clear recommendation, even if that means ARG is not the fit.
